page.overview:
Who is Naho Takada?

Naho is a light-skinned, young girl with black button-like eyes. Her black hair is parted in the middle with two braided twin tails tied with pale green butterfly clips.

Naho wears a long-sleeved, white nurse uniform with a bright green wrap tied into a bow around her waist. She wears white socks and sandals with bright green straps.

Similar to the other members of the trio, Naho is very bright, cheery, and helpful, despite the fact that her family was killed by demons.

After her family had been attacked by demons, Naho was taken in by the Butterfly Mansion by Kanae and Shinobu Kocho, along with Kiyo, Sumi and Aoi.
